svg.text: Bound exposure and fund transient copy peaks
Independent six-slot overcommit and shared-partial-tail references
Maximum demand is not backed credit
Six slots; one headroom; four blocks used
Four caps need eight blocks; ordinary five
Ratio 1.6; unbacked deficit three blocks
Next growth still needs safe funding
Four simultaneous appends; U only one
Wait/fund subset or qualified recovery
Deferred requests retain output history
Shared old tail has a surviving reader
A/B share full p0 and partial p1
A copies p1 to p2; B copies p1 to p3
Assigned block counts: 2 → 3 → 4
Peak differs from the final union
Old p1 remains Retiring until reader ends
Then four assigned blocks fall to three
Peak 2 MiB; final assigned 1.5 MiB
A sole current owner does not establish that old device readers have finished.
Copy traffic, reconstruction and headroom need separate budgets and end-to-end evidence.
